Dear Simen Aarre,
Thank you for reaching
out

Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset

ChargerID/Serial No.

Problem Description
: Charger offline
Please perform a physical reboot to the charger and check if it is still offline. If it remains offline, we need to check the router, including all its power connections and Ethernet cables. After this, verify if the charger is still offline. When heading to the site, please bring a spare router and a couple of Ethernet cables. In case the router is faulty, we can replace it,  if not, the spare equipment can be used for another charger next time.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0398492-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P9 170000355] Offline charger CRM:00643001198
additional_info.body:
Dear Simen Aarre,
Thanks for your support and patience, according to our records your issue/query has been resolved for case # 0398492, and the case is now closed.
Problem Description
: Offline charger
Resolution
: Charger had black display and red LEDs at arrival. RC Turned OFF, waited 1 minute and turned it back ON. Charger came online, with normal display and green LEDs.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shreyas Sathe
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
